mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% signals economic weakness, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal a broad economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and INDPRO decline but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth is positive but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1400 thousand units signal weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST falls below 1400 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), a decline in industrial production signals deteriorating economic conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO growth < 0.5% annually), INDPRO declines but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signal weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.
